Design preview — Reviews (new Inbox design)

The Reviews page now uses the approved option A "Inbox" layout: repositories 240 px, runs 340 px and the run detail. All captures come from the real Electron build of branch feat/reviews-machines-inbox-layout.

Sample data. The populated captures use SAMPLE DATA. The capture script puts four sample repositories (live, dry run, paused, disabled), eight sample runs and a next-page cursor into the real ReviewRunsStore. The layout, components and styles are the real build.

Remaining differences from the prototype

  1. The app shows its top navigation bar and the Workspaces and Git rails around the page. The prototype shows only the page.
  2. The app uses the glass theme surfaces (gold primary action). The prototype uses plain DaisyUI surfaces with a blue primary action.
  3. Not a chrome or theme difference, open: the header line has no attempt number ("Attempt 2" in the prototype). The run contract has only an attempt ID, not a number. The attempt ID is the tooltip of the line.
  4. Not a chrome or theme difference, open: the coverage tile counts the lenses that ran ("4 of 4 lenses completed"), from the lens records of the run. The run contract has no set of selected lenses, so a lens that was selected but did not start is not in the count. The tile shows "Lens count unavailable" when the run has no lens record. The strings of the coverage field show as "Coverage notes".
  5. Not a chrome or theme difference, owned by PR #1040: the Findings section is the current content of the branch, not the prototype table. PR #1040 replaces it with interactive cards.
  6. Not a chrome or theme difference, kept because they are real functions: "Review settings", the "All states" filter, the queued count and the "Last refreshed" line. The "Walkthrough preview" and "Artifacts" sections of the current product stay below the findings.
